role: explanatory photometric-system comparison on previously inspected native final fields; no new independent final test
reference: PS1 chunks-qz-star-v3, propagated Gaia DR3 positions at each PS1 mean epoch, unique match within one arcsec, PS1-to-DECam g/r/z polynomials already used in pilot_audit
quality: unambiguous unique match; PS1 g-i in (0.4,2.7); g,r,i,z median magnitudes 15-20, NMAG_OK >=3, and 0<STDEV<0.03 mag
primary_metric: per-field median and NMAD of Legacy observed minus transformed PS1 observed g,r,z on frozen selected cold anchors, with nside64 sky-block intervals
secondary_metric: same-source change in frozen-route predicted distance modulus when transformed PS1 grz replaces Legacy grz while WISE, Gaia parallax, source extinction, masks, forests, and WISE20 policy remain fixed; report common acceptance and p_corr>=2 mas separately
interpretation: relative optical measurement/transform diagnostic; PS1 and Legacy share photometric calibration ancestry, and transformation range truncates cold-dwarf colors
